scripts.dev: concurrently --handle-input --kill-signal SIGINT --kill-others -c "green,blue,cyan,magenta,white,yellow,red,gray" -n "turbo,unified-api,edi-as2,edi-orch,edi-compute,edi-config-sync,ucp-worker,identity-worker" "turbo run dev start:dev --log-order=stream" "cd core/platform/apps/unified-api && set -a && source ../../../../.env && set +a && ENVIRONMENT=development PYTHONPATH=src uv run uvicorn unified_api.main:app --port 3000 --reload --env-file ../../../../.env" "cd apps/edi && make dev-as2" "cd apps/edi && make dev-worker-orchestrator" "cd apps/edi && make dev-worker-compute" "cd apps/edi && make dev-worker-config-sync" "cd core/ucp/apps/ucp-worker && set -a && source ../../../../.env && set +a && ENVIRONMENT=development PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m ucp_worker.main" "cd core/platform/apps/identity-worker && set -a && source ../../../../.env && set +a && ENVIRONMENT=development PYTHONPATH=src uv run python -m identity_worker.main"
scripts.start:prd: turbo run build && turbo run start
scripts.db:generate: cd core/platform/packages/database && uv run alembic revision --autogenerate
scripts.db:migrate:platform: cd core/platform/packages/database && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: cd core/ucp/packages/ucp && uv run python scripts/seed.py
scripts.infra:clean-identity: cd core/ucp/packages/ucp && uv run python scripts/clear_zitadel.py
scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --wait postgres_global edi_postgres_shard localstack debezium_shard otel-collector && pnpm db:migrate && pnpm db:seed
scripts.infra-restart: docker compose restart postgres_global edi_postgres_shard localstack debezium_shard cdcproxy otel-collector
scripts.platform:up: pnpm platform:build && docker compose up -d unified-api edi-as2-server edi-orchestrator edi-compute-worker edi-config-sync-worker ucp-worker identity-worker notification-sweeper scheduler-engine
scripts.platform:down: docker compose stop unified-api edi-as2-server edi-orchestrator edi-compute-worker edi-config-sync-worker ucp-worker identity-worker notification-sweeper scheduler-engine
scripts.infra-reset: pnpm infra:clean-identity && pnpm infra:down && pnpm infra:up && pnpm infra:init-edi
scripts.ucp-reset: pnpm infra:clean-identity && pnpm infra:down && pnpm infra:up
scripts.soft-reset: pnpm infra:clean-identity && cd apps/edi && make sqs-purge
